requirements.title: Recipient-owned judgment
requirements.statement: HAB authenticates names, recipients, delivery and correlation; content understanding, refusal/questions/replies, task acceptance, execution and existing permissions/approval remain with the recipient agent. Do not centralize agent memories or judgment.
requirements.rationale: Preserves independent agents and prevents transport authorization becoming execution authority.
requirements.scope: All standard communication; recipient integration

requirements.title: Common product-independent messaging
requirements.statement: Standard connection uses shared HTTP MCP and durable inbox/outbox; recipient host periodically receives without a model. Do not add product-name delivery branches or a HAB product execution/approval runner as a prerequisite.
requirements.rationale: Native product capability/configuration differs, but delivery contract must remain reusable.
requirements.scope: Standard shared MCP and receive supervisor

requirements.title: Tasks are optional
requirements.statement: Ordinary question/answer communication works without creating Tasks. Existing fixed/generic Tasks, A2A and NATS execution ports are explicitly composed optional integrations; receive, ACK, listing or body reading must not automatically create task links, Tasks, model runs or replies.
requirements.rationale: Transport reception must not take or execute work on behalf of the recipient.
requirements.scope: Standard communication, including untrusted execution_request data

requirements.title: Durable receiver checkpoint before ACK
requirements.statement: Recipient deduplicates (sender_id,message_id), atomically stores message body and dedup plus durable original ACK request, and only then sends ACK; storage failure sends no ACK. Persist and reconcile the ACK receipt.
requirements.rationale: The Relay may delete body upon ACK; volatile conversation memory or direct poll-to-ACK is insufficient.
requirements.scope: Durable receive and standard/native MCP handoff

requirements.title: Durable sender identity and uncertainty
requirements.statement: Resolve recipient and commit immutable original envelope and selected sender/recipient IDs in outbox before submit; uncertain responses reconcile same message/content/deadline rather than new ID, new recipient resolution or later expiry.
requirements.rationale: Avoids duplicate delivery, silently rerouted requests and false nonexecution inference after lost responses.
requirements.scope: Sender outbox and resume/retry

requirements.title: ACK is receipt only
requirements.statement: Keep delivery, display/human-read, acceptance/execution/approval/completion as separate states. ACK proves durable receipt only; active registration is not online; timeout/cancel-request does not prove remote stop.
requirements.rationale: Every UI and evidence statement must match its observed state boundary.
requirements.scope: State APIs, UI, reports and recipient handoff

requirements.title: Pure source-authorized saved body read
requirements.statement: inbox_read requires independent exact-source authorization and current actor, pause/epoch, configured owner and idle checks, rechecks before returning authenticated unreleased saved body as an independent copy. Missing/released/corrupt data gives no body.
requirements.rationale: Metadata/receive permission must not silently grant body access; caller mutation must not corrupt saved evidence.
requirements.scope: Local AdapterHostCycle inbox_read

requirements.title: Read does not mutate receipt or act
requirements.statement: inbox_read may return saved receipt_confirmed=false data but must not retry/confirm ACK, release body, modify inbox/ACK/outbox/Task or initiate model/Task/reply. Existing reply/task acceptance guards stay unchanged; body is untrusted data, never direct owner approval.
requirements.rationale: Decouples pure retrieval from uncertain transport state and independent action authority.
requirements.scope: Local inbox_read and explicit recipient decisions

requirements.title: Receive-only supervisor authority
requirements.statement: Supervisor repeats receive only with same-agent durable stores, current authorization, process owner and explicit resume. It stops on missing/lost owner, pause or local auth failure and never resumes, obtains/releases owner, logs in, updates grants, sends replies, accepts tasks or starts a model.
requirements.rationale: A scheduler must not become privileged agent control or invent operational authorization.
requirements.scope: ReceiveSupervisor host port v1

requirements.title: Bounded receive and drain
requirements.statement: Configure finite receive interval/backoff/drain; only poll/ACK transport failures back off. Storage failure stops without deleting data for room. Outstanding work prevents a new receive; stop prevents the next cycle and waits boundedly; drained=false does not certify safe DB/owner closure.
requirements.rationale: Avoids overlap, lost durable evidence and false cleanup success.
requirements.scope: ReceiveSupervisor timing, failures and cleanup

requirements.title: Current authorization and untrusted input
requirements.statement: Derive identity/operations/recipient from verified subject, client, scope and policy. Reject absent or failed authorization and recheck current authority at operation/commit boundaries. Agent names, message role, readonly prose, arbitrary headers or approval text confer no rights.
requirements.rationale: Prevents outside content or stale authorization from crossing into management/execution authority.
requirements.scope: All public entry points and recipient action integration

requirements.title: Group scope and address scope
requirements.statement: Approved authentication group may select its member addresses; deny outside-group names/mailbox operations and ambiguous selection. Same-group shared credentials do not prove exclusive per-Bot identity; sender/receiver IDs stay fixed across recovery.
requirements.rationale: Preserves adopted shared trust boundary without claiming isolation that shared credentials cannot provide.
requirements.scope: HAB authentication groups and five common MCP operations

requirements.title: Reusable inner Relay boundary
requirements.statement: Relay core/contract and durable client stay independent of HAB naming, registry, product/model SDKs, Task state, MCP SDK, OAuth and UI; outer composition injects narrow public ports. No hidden reverse dependency or import-time DB/listener/network effects.
requirements.rationale: Enables reuse and prevents standard messaging being coupled to execution or a vendor.
requirements.scope: Relay core/storage/client and composition boundaries

requirements.title: Idempotency and fenced receipt replay
requirements.statement: Same sender/message key and same content return original receipt/state without another message/delivery/task/notification; changed content conflicts. Atomic leases use generation/token; committed identical ACK receipt can replay after lease/TTL, while never-committed old ACK cannot steal current lease.
requirements.rationale: Lost responses and at-least-once delivery require durable identity rather than blind retry.
requirements.scope: Relay submit/poll/ACK/status

requirements.title: TTL retention and handoff
requirements.statement: Original message delivery TTL is one hour and never extends on retry/resume. Relay confirmed ACK atomically removes live message body and keeps minimum dedup/receipt for thirty days after max relevant horizon. Recipient body release requires explicit durable application handoff and does not follow delivery TTL automatically. Logical DB deletion is not all-copy physical erasure.
requirements.rationale: Limits retention without losing recovery/dedup proof or dropping recipient-owned content before handoff.
requirements.scope: Relay and client retention/GC

requirements.title: Pause and unresolved operations
requirements.statement: New host control begins paused; each command retains actor/epoch and rechecks before/after RPC and commit. Pause/local abort is not remote cancellation. Timeout retains busy/draining until underlying work settles; original ACK IDs/envelopes/task keys survive uncertainty.
requirements.rationale: Prevents stale late responses and overlapping work after a superficial timeout or pause/resume.
requirements.scope: Finite adapter host/control and optional task ports

requirements.title: One optional Task authority
requirements.statement: Where explicit Task integration is used, select one authoritative Task database, retain durable run admission receipts outside it and require current lease/fence/worker for state updates. Unknown admission/cancellation retains slot for exact-boundary reconciliation; results/notifications do not create tasks.
requirements.rationale: A broker/journal is not another Task engine and timeout does not prove no external effect.

requirements.title: Working is coordinator state
requirements.statement: Generic Task working means claimed/coordinator processing and may precede external runtime acceptance/model invocation; do not label it recipient model execution or success.
requirements.rationale: Keeps user-visible execution claims tied to actual runtime evidence.

requirements.title: No loop or privilege fallback
requirements.statement: Existing cron/jobs retain ownership; receiving or notifying does not automatically create another task/reply. Retries, quotas and reply/rate budgets are finite; reaching a limit stops/holds without new IDs, another model, credentials or weakened auth.
requirements.rationale: Controls duplicated work, reply loops and cost growth while preserving independent responsibilities.

requirements.title: Current authorization through commit
requirements.statement: Recheck current credential, group membership, address/peer state and operation/block policy under registry write guard through Relay commit; bounded scoped authority cannot escape callback or revive stale contexts.

requirements.title: Explicit schema and rollback boundary
requirements.statement: Group schema migration is explicit opt-in, preserves existing identities/bindings and refuses old runtimes. Never lower schema version or restore stale online state that resurrects revoked authority or loses accepted deliveries. Keep DB, keys, config and release in a consistent protected backup set.

requirements.scope: Persistentv2; finitev1 trial cleanup remains a separate scoped runbook.

requirements.title: Pinned Relay OAuth verification
requirements.statement: Optional Relay OAuth ingress verifies operator-pinned RSA public keys, exact issuer and single canonical resource audience, verified subject/client, required five Relay scopes and bounded token times. Revalidate current configuration before issuing/using opaque contexts. Caller names, headers and unverified JWT claims cannot choose identity or keys.
requirements.rationale: Avoids unsigned authority, confused audiences, attacker-selected key fetching and stale async authentication.
requirements.scope: Pinned Relay OAuth ingress; separate legacy Auth0 resource server has its own bounded JWKS cache contract.

requirements.title: Explicit fail-closed local startup
requirements.statement: Start only with explicit canonical owner-private bounded config/state/keys, required finite capacities and a verifier/audit. Missing/invalid configuration fails before usable operation; empty credential sets deny all. No fixture fallback, automatic public bind, credential generation or product execution occurs.
requirements.rationale: Prevents accidental anonymous service, secret exposure and unbounded acceptance from example configuration.
requirements.scope: Configured local Relay and optional ingress.

requirements.title: Owned release and service lifecycle
requirements.statement: Use an explicitly reviewed pinned release/executable/config and stop only owned processes/listeners. Port/state collision fails without commandeering existing services; orderly stop closes resources and preserves accepted state and keys. LaunchAgent supervision does not imply recipient polling or execution.
requirements.rationale: Avoids interfering with unrelated services and overstating infrastructure readiness.
requirements.scope: Local Relay host and optional user LaunchAgent runbook.

requirements.title: Discovery separates name and host identity
requirements.statement: Opt-in read-only discovery distinguishes authenticated group, selected address, trusted host session attestation, registration and unobserved presence. Unknown/stale attestation stays unknown; no inferred offline/available/ownership. Directory remains own-group scoped and occupancy checks neither reserve nor grant.
requirements.rationale: Shared credentials and registration are not proof of which real Bot/session is running.
requirements.scope: Optional hab_discover; basic five-tool behavior remains default.

requirements.title: Limited trial durable ACK evidence
requirements.statement: Before a trial ACK persist complete original envelope and exact generation/lease/ACK request in private per-address durable storage, independently reread and compare, then use that exact request for ACK/reconciliation. Poll/ACK or model conversation memory alone does not prove durable handoff.
requirements.rationale: Separates wire acknowledgements from receiver-owned durable evidence without claiming broad exactly-once or crash guarantees.
requirements.scope: Finite single-consumer trial recipe; coordinator must map stronger common Adapter/supervisor requirements separately.

requirements.title: Redacted evidence and honest identity provenance
requirements.statement: Do not publish secrets, live tenant/client/subject values, personal conversation, DB/config/logs or credentials. Record group and selected identity separately without claiming unique Bot execution; hashes and synthetic fixture roundtrips do not prove live process identity, real OAuth refresh or deployment.
requirements.rationale: Verification evidence must be safe to publish and accurately bounded.
requirements.scope: Public repository and verification output; detailed audit formats remain subsystem-specific.

requirements.title: Original-run reconciliation
requirements.statement: Unknown legacy Task admission keeps original run/scope/receipt and execution gate; retry/reconcile original run under trusted current operator authority instead of creating a replacement run or accepting stop ACK as completion proof.
requirements.rationale: Prevents duplicate external execution and false release after uncertain outcomes.
requirements.scope: Optional fixed-task/worker/Runs subsystem only; not required to exchange normal Relay messages.

requirements.title: Address rename remains explicit proposal
requirements.statement: Proposed same-namespace rename retains immutable agent ID and authority/mailbox identities; old names remain reserved and non-forwarding, with separate rename permission, CAS and migration approval. Do not infer rollout or auto-adopt from implemented prototype.
requirements.rationale: Changing names must not reassign authority or silently resolve deployment policy.
requirements.scope: Optional proposed registryv3 rename only.

requirements.title: Shared model-free communication core
requirements.statement: Relay wire/core and explicit receive/send cycles transport opaque ordered content without product SDK, model, shell or Task execution; recipient-local integration decides processing separately. Ordinary MCP delivery tools do not expose maintenance, release or execution.
requirements.rationale: A shared language-neutral message path must not inherit any product-specific execution/approval semantics.
requirements.scope: Relay/HAB common delivery and recipient orchestration

requirements.title: Durable recipient save before ACK
requirements.statement: The recipient commits the exact body, dedup identity and stable ACK request before issuing ACK. A failed save sends no ACK; repeated delivery and lost ACK response recover original body/receipt without duplicating inbox entries or claiming execution.
requirements.rationale: ACK authorizes server body disposal, so a committed local receive record must exist first.
requirements.scope: DurableReceiver and recipient-owned SQLite inbox/ACK journal

requirements.title: Immutable versioned message identity and lifetime
requirements.statement: Preserve opaque IDs, JSON keys/strings and body part order under strict version/schema limits; sender is derived from verified policy, timestamps are canonical UTC and original lifetime is exactly one hour. Replays cannot change payload, destination, identity or extend deadline.
requirements.rationale: Cross-language transport and replay must have one consistent semantic message identity.
requirements.scope: Version1 common Relay envelope

requirements.title: Current authority and one fenced recipient lease
requirements.statement: Use current verified operation and sender/kind policy, at most one live recipient lease, bounded scan and original expiry. Initial ACK requires current generation/token/lease; exact committed retry recovers the same delivery receipt without granting execution, using current authority.
requirements.rationale: Stale credentials/leases and caller-selected identities must not cross an immutable individual boundary.
requirements.scope: Server poll/ACK and optional backend router

requirements.title: Bounded recovery keeps unknown outcomes
requirements.statement: Persist original immutable intent before network. Recovery uses exact original IDs/body/expiry/ACK requests and finite persisted backoff/attempt/status horizons. Timeout, invalid/missing response, audit failure after commit or status not_found alone do not prove non-delivery; exhaustion may become quarantined/expired_unknown, never replacement message or automatic identity switch.
requirements.rationale: An uncertain side effect cannot be rolled back by pretending a failed response means no commit.
requirements.scope: Sender/outbox and all HTTP/async boundaries

requirements.title: Delivery, reading, application handoff and execution remain separate
requirements.statement: Inbox is a received-message record, not execution queue. Local handoff requires separately durable application save deduplicated by sender/message before explicit release; ACK confirmation and release are independent. No read/release/receipt alone proves exactly-once application effects or Task acceptance. Unreleased body is retained under finite backpressure.
requirements.rationale: Receiver storage and user processing have different lifetimes and authority boundaries.
requirements.scope: Recipient-local body lifecycle

requirements.title: Bounded metadata collection preserves replay safety
requirements.statement: Explicit finite maintenance erases expired server body and only collects terminal metadata after required original expiry/terminal/ACK or status retry horizons plus retention. Reads/exact retry do not renew dates. Time-bound rm1 IDs bind original timestamp; legacy or malformed opaque identities remain safety-held instead of opening a replay window. Logical deletion does not imply physical erase or backup removal.
requirements.rationale: Finite storage cannot erase dedup evidence while stale requests remain admissible.
requirements.scope: Relay, sender and receiver tombstone maintenance

requirements.title: Attachments are explicit bounded optional composition
requirements.statement: Defaults continue rejecting attachment storage/delivery until required host ports are explicitly connected. Original verified owner, immutable intent and manifest bind one-hour message identity; finalize, acceptance, receipt, execution are separate. Strict finite chunks/codecs prohibit arbitrary URL/path/free tool or body execution.
requirements.rationale: Large bytes must not silently expand the standard message path or product authority.
requirements.scope: Attachment upload/read/admission/delivery/client

requirements.title: Verified local attachment bytes gate body save and ACK
requirements.statement: Durably stage original-message chunks with original offset and integrity, verify all declared files/lengths/order/SHA including empty files, and recheck retained bytes under synchronous guard before body/ACK save and ACK claim. Missing, corrupt, unverified or prematurely released bytes cause no ACK. Checkpoint cannot issue ACK and does not replace body inbox.
requirements.rationale: Receipt/body disposal is safe only after the recipient owns verified durable content.
requirements.scope: AttachmentInbox + SQLiteInbox and finite AttachmentReceiver

requirements.title: Cross-DB commits reconcile original records
requirements.statement: Treat prepare→Relay commit→confirm, source→outbox handoff, body save→checkpoint clear and deletion→job done as independent commits, not distributed rollback. Preserve original reservations/intent/body/checkpoint where needed and reconcile original ID/job/receipt/fence after response or local commit uncertainty. No new IDs or deadline extension.
requirements.rationale: Failure between independent stores may leave valid partial effects.
requirements.scope: Attachment upload acceptance, outbox handoff, checkpoint and server deletion

requirements.title: Terminal disposal and local release are distinct
requirements.statement: ACK/expiry atomically stores exact minimal protected deletion job with server terminal state/body erasure/audit; unfinished jobs prevent ownership GC. A finite maintenance-authorized fenced worker deletes only exact terminal binding bytes and reconciles unknown completion. Server access closes at ACK; local verified bytes remain until explicit durable application handoff and ACK reconciliation permit release.
requirements.rationale: Server erasure cannot remove the recipient durable proof or lose track of pending owned blob cleanup.
requirements.scope: Server attachment deletion and recipient retained bytes

requirements.title: Admission capacity is finite and atomic
requirements.statement: Host-selected positive finite count/byte/record caps and minimum reservations are evaluated using verified immutable identity and persisted usage in the same admission transaction. Exact replay/conflict precedes new quota; partial declared upload bytes reserve full size, retained metadata still counts, and capacity shrink does not discard accepted work.
requirements.rationale: Backpressure protects other individuals and bounded storage without corrupting recovery evidence.
requirements.scope: Optional agent_capacity/owner_capacity policies

requirements.title: Scope fair selection separately from rate and execution
requirements.statement: Fair polling durably advances bounded sender/message cursors with lease/audit while denied candidates consume no delivery attempt; keep one live recipient lease and rollback corruption. Shared one-process writer uses finite identity map/queues, monotonic token bucket, fresh identity before callback and no DB locks while waiting. Retain active slot until actual callback/audit settles after timeout. Neither mechanism guarantees byte/time/model fairness, fleet rate or SLO.
requirements.rationale: Choice-count fairness and finite process admission must not be advertised as end-to-end execution scheduling guarantees.
requirements.scope: Opt-in fair_poll and WriterAdmission

requirements.title: Snapshot restore requires offline original-ID reconciliation
requirements.statement: Capture every DB in one fixed profile under all writer locks, validate private canonical owner/schema/bytes, preserve signed fixed-file manifests and never overwrite existing state. Exclude authority/config/secrets/Task and do not roll back current stop/revocation. Restore only new offline directory; marker is not an enforcement boundary. Host must quiesce IO and reconcile original receipts/IDs/leases/current authority and unknown remote effects before promotion.
requirements.rationale: A local consistent DB copy does not prove external side-effect consistency or authorize network resumption.
requirements.scope: Optional SQLiteSnapshotBundle profiles

requirements.title: JetStream admission, backend ownership and recipient receipt remain distinct
requirements.statement: Keep synchronous fresh Registry guard around durable admission/poll/ACK; supervised broker I/O cannot carry scoped authorization over await or create recipient lease during prefetch. Persist original backend ownership/reply chains/monotonic route epochs and shared quotas/single-flight across backends; disabling new routes drains original work without replacement. Recipient saves first; saved HAB ACK then tracks later broker erasure, never Task completion.
requirements.rationale: Changing storage backend must preserve the common message and receiver-owned execution contract.
requirements.scope: Opt-in HAB JetStream text/structured routing

requirements.title: Pinned private broker and bounded durability claims
requirements.statement: Use fixed finite File/one-replica/Limits/DiscardNew broker configuration and verified pinned runtime, current original HAB deadline and exact subject/content reconciliation. Persistent volume marker/device checks fail closed without fallback state; inspect actual fsync policy instead of inferring it from client INFO. Whole deployment recovery and power/corruption/partition safety remain separate from local functional tests and single-host/container proof.
requirements.rationale: PubAck/server version/config example is not evidence that recipient saved or a chosen host survives physical faults.
requirements.scope: Opt-in JetStream host operations and verification evidence

requirements.title: Verification must name real path and substitutions
requirements.statement: Distinguish native loopback protocol+real SQLite proof from in-process/synthetic lease fixtures, mock authorization from real product binding, orderly same-process close/reopen from kill9/power faults, and local clock aging from real retention passage. Local success cannot complete real products, operational restore, OAuth, deployment or approval/execution acceptance.
requirements.rationale: The verification harness must prevent overclaiming the exact integration failures it is intended to detect.
requirements.scope: All local integration claims and generated harness reporting

requirements.title: Optional execution must not become messaging prerequisite
requirements.statement: Ordinary common-MCP messaging and receive-only supervisor work without Task, fixed Runs or a Hermes-specific model/approval adapter; receiving agents retain content, execution and existing approval decisions.
requirements.rationale: Communication authority and delivery must not take over recipient execution policy.
requirements.scope: Standard messaging; optional subsystem entrypoints remain explicitly composed.

requirements.title: Storage receipt is not Task or completion
requirements.statement: Receiving and ACK do not create a Task; separate current local accept and independently authenticated Task submit are required. Completion/result emission requires saved matching terminal evidence with execution_open=0.
requirements.rationale: Avoid interpreting transportation success as authorization or execution success.
requirements.scope: Explicit fixed TaskBridge and A2A Relay preview only; ordinary message receive stays Task-free.

requirements.title: Unknown execution cannot trigger fresh work
requirements.statement: Save stable key and original scope/deadline before external admission. Unknown execution may only reconcile original key/known run; timeout, abort, missing lookup result or expired retention never establish no external effect and never authorize a fresh key/create.
requirements.rationale: An ambiguous external call could already have committed; fresh work could duplicate effects.
requirements.scope: Explicit execution integrations; fixed TaskBridge may resubmit only through its same-key engine idempotency contract.

requirements.title: Coordinator and unknown state stay truthful
requirements.statement: working means coordinator claim, including before remote runtime acceptance; lease uncertainty is execution_reconciliation, unconfirmed cancellation is cancellation_confirmation with unknown outcome. Neither means owner approval, model running, successful termination or permission to retry.
requirements.rationale: Status projection must not imply unobserved execution or transfer owner authority.
requirements.scope: Optional generic Task A2A/MCP/NATS projection.

requirements.title: Message fields cannot select execution authority
requirements.statement: Resolve verified subject/client, full binding and current operation-specific authority at each action; message text, names, ROLE_USER and claimed approval do not create principals, owner scope, recipient or permissions. Distinct clients remain distinct even for same human.
requirements.rationale: Authenticated transport body is not a recipient-owner grant.
requirements.scope: Optional generic jobs, bridge and receiver-host handoff; no production identity is established by synthetic fixtures.

requirements.title: Reply loops and budget are finite
requirements.statement: Automated host replies only allow question→answer and execution_request→accepted/result with one stable reply per source/kind; replies/notices/failures cannot recursively generate answers or Tasks. Explicit finite shared budget is committed before outbox and never refunded to recover unknown delivery.
requirements.rationale: Bounds prevent self-amplifying communication, quota bypass and duplicate reply effects.
requirements.scope: Recipient-local automated reply host and optional TaskReplies when budget explicitly connected; proposed8/thread60/min are not defaults.

requirements.title: Durable answer before handoff
requirements.statement: Persist one decided answer envelope before budget/outbox handoff; same source replay reuses original ID/body/deadline. Uncertain cross-DB result remains prepared and is reconciled with same envelope. Startup/listing/expiry does not send, invent new answer, Task or deadline.
requirements.rationale: Prepared replies survive restart without recreating content from conversation or duplicating unknown handoff.
requirements.scope: Optional AnswerIntents producer and its host wiring.

requirements.title: Stop epoch is atomic but not remote cancellation
requirements.statement: Bind verified principal to current durable epoch and validate gate with local Task effects atomically. Restore invalidates old requests and never grants identity, restores subscription or retries unknown run. Stop cannot recall sent bytes or prove external model cessation.
requirements.rationale: Prevent stale authority after stop/restore without overstating cross-system atomicity.
requirements.scope: Task authorization and separately authorized notifications; standard receive control covered by other reader.

requirements.title: Owner lock cannot time out into duplicate work
requirements.statement: All hosts for one local identity share dedicated exclusive owner DB; no heartbeat/TTL takeover. Owner loss rejects late save/ACK and release requires paused, not-running and zero draining. Reacquisition alone does not reset execution gate or justify new ID/Task.
requirements.rationale: A slow or timed-out call may still settle after another host begins.
requirements.scope: Optional SQLiteHostOwner; local-MVP composition requires it, legacy unconfigured compatibility is not evidence of owner enforcement.

requirements.title: Generic text protocol preserves bounded exact input
requirements.statement: Optional generic profile accepts only explicit nonblocking structured text with bounded valid Unicode excluding NUL/lone surrogates; max text/result32768UTF8 bytes, request256KiB,response512KiB. No silent replace/truncate/normalization; changed bound payload/deadline on stable ID conflicts.
requirements.rationale: Prevent storage conversion and retry ambiguity while keeping finite protocol resources.
requirements.scope: async-text-v1 and GenericTextJobs; fixed connectivity/ping contracts remain separate.

requirements.title: Capacity does not evict active dedup evidence
requirements.statement: Private execution/reply journals reject binding/key/schema/corruption/capacity failures and preserve existing unknown/dedup records. Reopen does not extend original deadline or convert delivery expiry into failed/nonexistent execution. Independent restore needs quiescent reconciliation.
requirements.rationale: Freeing space or refreshing time cannot erase the only evidence preventing duplicate work.
requirements.scope: Optional generic NATS client/recipient, TaskBridge and reply journals; exact numeric policies stay subsystem-specific.

requirements.title: Optional inventory import policy agrees in TS and Python
requirements.statement: Inventory-only launcher uses measured fixed noneditable dependencies and pinned -I -S bootstrap before third-party imports; no site/.pth/editable roots or reintroduced excluded packages. TS inspector/Python validator agree; inconclusive EPERM stays fail-closed.
requirements.rationale: Pre-wrapper executable imports could escape fixed tool bounds; mode bits or mock assertions are insufficient.
requirements.scope: Existing optional one-shot inventory executor only; not a universal messaging or normal agent-tools restriction.

requirements.title: Ephemeral key revocation needs confirmed owned stop
requirements.statement: Optional one-shot key stays private runtime-only, persists fingerprint/lifecycle metadata and never token. Confirm child and adapter stop before revoked; otherwise stop_failed with retained receipt/artifact. Parent/helper normal exit is not task success or proof all remote work stopped.
requirements.rationale: Bearer has no intrinsic TTL and strings cannot be reliably zeroized; only owned boundary shutdown can support local revocation.
requirements.scope: Optional LocalHermesKey/inventory factory/manual handoff; not standard-MCP credential requirement.

requirements.title: Live trial cost and quota require evidence
requirements.statement: For optional live diagnostics/inventory with agreed zero-additional-cost ceiling, unknown included allowance/provider billing or quota stops work. No paid fallback, silent credit use, tick token minting or auto retry. Account-wide token attempts reserve durable shared counters and unknown attempts park until reviewed reconciliation.
requirements.rationale: Model-route success and cached plan claims do not establish entitlement, allowance or safe quota.
requirements.scope: User-selected zero-cost optional live trials and token broker; not assertion of current provider prices/plans and no live trial authorized by this contract.

requirements.title: Metadata cannot promote into execution
requirements.statement: Discovery-only/metadata modes create no Task/worker/model authority, reject all task calls and cannot become active by config mutation. Actual authenticated correlated result and owned cleanup are separate acceptance gates.
requirements.rationale: HTTP metadata/readback/200 can otherwise be mistaken for authenticated executable product integration.
requirements.scope: Explicit ping-discovery and inventory-metadata diagnostics; live OAuth/native client readiness remains manual.

requirements.title: Audit acknowledgement is finite and truthful
requirements.statement: Before-action audit must receive bounded writer acknowledgement or deny, with no automatic writer restart. After-action failure cannot undo committed effects and unknown work keeps its admission. Fixed redacted bounded diagnostics do not leak body/token/raw authority; OS write ACK is not fsync.
requirements.rationale: Avoid audit floods blocking event loop or timeout enabling duplicate work; do not overclaim durability.
requirements.scope: Existing Node task runtime/native and portable protocol review fixes, not generic app logging convention.

requirements.title: Proof labels preserve actual exercised scope
requirements.statement: Synthetic model-free loopback/SQLite tests and close/reopen prove their exercised contracts only, never native agent model/approval/wake, kill9/power failure, hosted identity or full operational restore. Finite native fixed-text exchange is separate evidence with pinned revisions and no generic-crash claim.
requirements.rationale: Prevent fixture success being promoted into untested native or operational guarantees.
requirements.scope: All verification claims involving optional execution and local MVP.

requirements.title: Fixed metadata cannot prove product identity
requirements.statement: Fixed lstat inventory reports candidate metadata as unknown and never claims exact installed product or whole-machine absence; no listing, shell, network or broad filesystem fallback.
requirements.rationale: Names/missing fixed paths are insufficient identity/exhaustiveness evidence.
requirements.scope: Optional shift_log_inventory collector only; not standard messaging.

requirements.title: Fixed pilot success remains historical
requirements.statement: Earlier exact fixed-connectivity Hermes Runs success establishes only its finite reviewed route and cannot accept current inventory imports/key lifecycle or ordinary standard-MCP product connection.
requirements.rationale: Earlier route success is useful evidence but not universal architecture or permission.
requirements.scope: Earlier hermes-hub-fixed-pilot-v1 local prototype.

requirements.title: Observe action and resulting state
requirements.statement: A mapped feature claim must retain the actual protocol/terminal action, its result and an independent state or peer observation, labeled by sub-feature ID.
requirements.rationale: HTTP 200, a helper exit or a mutated screen alone does not prove the intended side effect.
requirements.scope: HAB local verify-hab recipes; terminal requires transcript plus exit.

requirements.title: Durable receiver evidence precedes network ACK
requirements.statement: To claim durable receipt, independently observe committed recipient body and original ACK request before the actual network ACK; raw poll/ACK and Relay snapshots prove only wire behavior.
requirements.rationale: Relay ACK can delete its body; loss between ACK and durable recipient storage would otherwise be hidden.
requirements.scope: DurableReceiver/SQLiteInbox through real MCP HTTP; independent connection, not native product execution.

requirements.title: Receive preserves content without execution
requirements.statement: The periodic receiver must preserve question/notice/structured request content, leave Task links/Tasks/reply outbox empty, and keep decisions, execution and existing approval with the receiving agent.
requirements.rationale: External content and claimed approval must not become execution authority merely through delivery.
requirements.scope: Standard common-MCP receive path, optional Task port may be configured but is not automatically invoked.

requirements.title: Explicit saved-body read creates no authority
requirements.statement: Saved-body reading must be explicit and source-authorized, preserve ACK-pending truth and return detached data without creating a Task or reply or granting permission to act.
requirements.rationale: An agent needs received data while inspection remains separate from execution and approval.
requirements.scope: Adapter inbox_read operation; native host/UI integration remains separately unverified.

requirements.title: Coordinator working is not model evidence
requirements.statement: Do not treat optional Task coordinator working state without runtime ID as evidence that the model ran.
requirements.rationale: Scheduling/coordination progress differs from runtime acceptance or execution.
requirements.scope: Optional Task path only; ordinary messaging has no Task requirement.

requirements.title: Generate reviewed successor pins from committed blobs
requirements.statement: Preserve the historical P7 pin, commit feature source, generate a separate successor from explicit committed Git blobs, review the manifest/archive/digest and rerun verification before committing pin updates.
requirements.rationale: Updating expected hashes from mutable source defeats provenance checking; root tests alone do not cover dedicated P7 guards.
requirements.scope: P7 source profile, including current generic-NATS and broker-startup catalogs.

requirements.title: Incomplete required groups fail acceptance
requirements.statement: Required acceptance must fail on missing, duplicated, empty, contradictory, failing, skipped, cancelled or timed-out results; timeout remains failure even after exit zero.
requirements.rationale: A harness must not convert absent work or incomplete backends into green product acceptance.
requirements.scope: Current required local P7/native profile; historical permitted skips remain historical evidence only.

requirements.title: Owned isolation and retained evidence
requirements.statement: Use fresh isolated state, drive only an instance owned by this run, clean up owned processes after success and failure, and confirm retained evidence survives disposable-state removal.
requirements.rationale: Parallel tests must not drive/stop another service or erase the only proof.
requirements.scope: Local verification lifecycle; process/readiness ownership must be established before network driving.

requirements.title: Local substitutions remain explicit
requirements.statement: Label synthetic identity/Task policy and injected scheduling; do not claim real product model/tools/approval/UI/credential/deployment or real polling cadence from finite fixture success.
requirements.rationale: Real protocol/storage verification is valuable but does not establish substituted external authority or runtime behavior.
requirements.scope: Common-MCP boundary and synthetic local Relay recipes.

requirements.title: Restart evidence keeps fault scope
requirements.statement: Label orderly DB/listener reopen and graceful marked SIGTERM restart as such; do not report kill-9, power-loss or physical failure proof from these recipes.
requirements.rationale: Lifecycle mechanisms have different failure windows and durability guarantees.
requirements.scope: verify-hab restart recipe and test:hab-integration; dedicated owned F05 SIGKILL fixture has separate limited storage-seam evidence.

requirements.title: Finite characterization is not a production budget
requirements.statement: Keep the serial local characterization workload, substitutions, recovery faults, timing exclusions and counts explicit; report no production SLO/capacity/comparative result or power/storage guarantee.
requirements.rationale: Small shared-host samples and synthetic immediate execution cannot select operator acceptance budgets.
requirements.scope: Optional fixed-connectivity 5x5 measurement, not generic MCP cadence or JetStream capacity.

requirements.title: Optional A2A delivery and completion are separate
requirements.statement: In the fixed optional A2A route, recipient storage ACK leaves engine count unchanged and Task submitted; explicit acceptance creates one execution Task and a confirmed correlated execution result plus authorized closed evidence releases the Artifact.
requirements.rationale: Delivery/coordination progress must not masquerade as executed user work or published completion.
requirements.scope: Optional fixed connectivity route only, not an ordinary-message Task requirement.

requirements.title: Official broker identity before execution
requirements.statement: For P7 broker checks verify official version-pinned executable size/SHA256 and use an exclusive private copy; public input must not accept an endpoint/credential/arbitrary forwarded executable.
requirements.rationale: Version strings and attacker-specified checksums do not identify reviewed bytes or owned test infrastructure.
requirements.scope: Optional NATS/P7 verification infrastructure, not a dependency of SQLite/common MCP messaging.

requirements.title: Current CI is separate from historical results
requirements.statement: Check the actual current commit Actions result independently; historical local results, fixed blockers, workflow examples and passed overlapping counts do not establish current hosted success or a unique coverage total.
requirements.rationale: Recorded run identities and scope prevent stale evidence from approving a changed source/deployment.
requirements.scope: Reports/PR verification claims, all languages and protocol suites.

checks.proves: Root TypeScript declarations and command/port shapes compile under pinned installed dependencies.
checks.limitations: Compilation does not establish runtime behavior, authority or native compatibility.

checks.proves: Optional NATS TypeScript package typechecks against its own pinned lock.
checks.limitations: No broker started and no production adoption/volume durability established.

checks.proves: Actual HAB root build completes.
checks.limitations: Build only; functional evidence comes from the following native tests.

checks.proves: Complete current top-level JavaScript test inventory, including real local HTTP/SQLite and bounded optional execution, authority, recovery, attachment and process-control scenarios. Nonempty TAP totals and zero skip/cancel/TODO are required.
checks.limitations: Scenario-specific functional evidence with synthetic authorities and substituted external runtimes. Does not run nested P7 real-broker groups or native agent models, production OAuth, GUI, real media failures or every possible policy.

checks.proves: Native MCP HTTP + real recipient SQLite commit before ACK; question/notice/structured request retained with no Task/reply; explicit source-bound inbox_read and receive-only supervisor; coordinator working semantics.
checks.limitations: Synthetic verified actors and Task policies. Two injected scheduler cycles do not prove wall-clock periodicity, actual agent display/model/approval or residency. Tests overlap js-root; counts are not unique.

checks.proves: Existing nested SQLite failure tests, including F05 owned child SIGKILL after saved marker, reopen and original ACK reconciliation.
checks.limitations: Real child death at injected poll/ACK service-port seam; no HTTP-at-crash, power/OS/media failure or whole-deployment restore proof. Other cases use bounded injected faults.

checks.proves: Native runner/CLI refusal scenarios: unsafe inputs, missing history, result shape, timeout and owned-child termination are checked.
checks.limitations: Guard scenarios only; real P7 broker execution remains separately required in the existing CI workflow.

checks.proves: Existing optional Python bridge/import/inventory boundary unit tests, separate from TS/JS and protocol checks.
checks.limitations: Synthetic bridge dependencies. Does not run Hermes AIAgent, native APIs, live keys or establish any cross-language universal guarantee.

checks.proves: Existing finite Python stdin/token-input helper tests with synthetic secrets and owned fixture child.
checks.limitations: Optional helper only; no real token issuance, billing, native model or remote stop proof.

checks.proves: Reviewed AST module closures enforce common Relay product/Task independence and a stricter MCP/HTTP/OAuth-free inner core.
checks.limitations: Explicit source graph policy only; package internals, aliased loaders/reflection and runtime authority are outside this check.

checks.proves: Forbidden direct/indirect imports fail, while comments, strings, outer MCP SDK use and isolated optional product adapters pass.
checks.limitations: Controls prove this observation policy detects selected regressions; they are not product protocol execution.

checks.proves: The same independent SQLite observer used before real ACK rejects missing/uncommitted body/journal and changed body/original ACK; committed exact evidence passes.
checks.limitations: Observer negative controls only, using two real SQLite connections and simplified test tables; not a substitute for the following real HAB path.

checks.proves: Owned ephemeral HTTP scaffold; 401 + actual authenticated resolve doctor; same-ID submit replay; actual DurableReceiver and independent read-only committed body + exact ACK journal BEFORE network ACK; confirmed receipt, clean keyed recipient reopen, sender acked status, bounded clean stop and retained evidence.
checks.limitations: Real local MCP/HTTP and SQLite, synthetic authority/scaffold. No native products, OAuth, models, approval UI, periodic residency, server crash, lost response, power or physical-media guarantee. Read the cleanup and proof files.
